role: independent research cross-review; no production writes

primaryAbstracts.findings: All seven trials agree with stored numerical results, CIs, primary endpoints, randomized versus analyzed population distinctions, and summarized harms. No numerical draft corrections identified.

dateChecks.andromeda-shock-2: Publisher previously independently retrieved first-online October 29, 2025, matching draft. PubMed XML has no ArticleDate field; do not substitute print date.

April 23 can be retained only on original verified publisher History evidence; do not describe that one-day discrepancy as independently resolved by this review.

guidelineChecks.verified: 129 total/46 new; at least 30 mL/kg within 3 h conditional/low certainty specifically in sepsis-induced hypoperfusion or shock; MAP65 strong/moderate; peripheral pressors conditional/very low; antibiotic stratification matches draft.
guidelineChecks.correctionAssessment: Public author-institution correction abstract specifies removal of trailing c characters from four author names. No clinical changes stated. Publisher correction body/PDF remains subscription-only; do not claim complete publisher-PDF review.

Current AHA synopsis agrees on eligible alteplase/tenecteplase4.5h, disabling deficits regardless NIHSS, basilarEVT24h NIHSS>=10, and against intensiveSBP<140 after reperfusion.
guidelineChecks.correctionAssessment: Seven-page August correction identified. Both official PDF and ePDF returned403; full contents were not reviewed. Cannot establish effects on every selected recommendation. Hold until complete correction is reviewed; no third-party PDF or access bypass used.

guidelineChecks.verified: Previously retrieved primary guideline tables agree on risk categories, outpatient-versus-hospital approach, anticoagulation/DOAC classes and caution with advanced therapies. Same co-publication must not be duplicated.

historicalFraming: All records must receive parent backfill metadata and the historical-collection label before publication; do not present these as new current-week evidence. Guideline imperative phrasing should be visibly anchored to its dated historical source. Pediatric sepsis already flags the later PRoMPT trial; adult sepsis says later trials may not be incorporated.
publicationRecommendation: Ten of eleven have no identified numerical/clinical discrepancy in the checked claims. Hold stroke because complete correction effects remain unresolved. Complete annual literature coverage is not certified.
